text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O got injured during training,
so I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, it was due to my carelessness...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll take notes on how the injury happened
and make sure not to make the same mistake again...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If we survey the people coming to the nurse's office
about the situations in which they got injured,
it might be helpful for everyone.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Alright, shall we head back
to our training then?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
There's a little bit of pain,
but I don't think it'll be an issue for running.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I cannot simply sit still
while everyone else is training!
choice_data_list: I understand how you feel, but you should rest.
Okay, let's explore what we can do

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Understood. I'll make sure to get plenty of rest today so my injury heals quickly.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I was the one who caused it in the first place, so please don't worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O sounded disappointed
as she made her way back to the dormitory.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Ow-ow-ow... It might hurt even more than before...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, it really would be better
if I just stopped, wouldn't it...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying so, Sakura Chiyono O
returned to the dormitory, looking full of regret.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Phew... It seems running at full speed is out of the question,
but I'll look for things I can do right now!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Above all, staying positive feels like
the best medicine for an injury!
After all, 'running is faster than worrying'!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though the injury seemed to linger,
Sakura Chiyono O trained carefully within her limits.
